items.name: mus_morning2
items.text: Funny, bouncy Chinese folk comedy theme for a cheeky cooking vlog starring a jolly, greedy old poet: staccato plucked pipa and guzheng play a mischievous tiptoeing melody, a plucked zhongruan bass bounces on the off-beats, comic woodblock and temple-block hits, playful pitch bends and little slides like a wink, now and then a short squeaky suona note as a punchline, G major pentatonic, 120 bpm, witty, sunny and light, it starts at once with the plucked melody. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_huangzhou2
items.text: A mock-grand, tongue-in-cheek flashback: a pompous, overly serious bamboo flute (dizi) melody over a slow gong roll, answered by a cheeky plucked pipa phrase, nostalgic and funny, an old man bragging about the pork he invented, D major pentatonic, 76 bpm. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_noon2
items.text: Lazy comic nap music: a sleepy, sliding erhu yawns over tiptoeing pizzicato guzheng plucks, a sly little melody that keeps nearly dozing off, woodblock ticks like a clock, cheeky and drowsy, a funny old man stuffing himself with lychees in the shade, G major pentatonic, 84 bpm. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_evening2
items.text: Warm and gently funny evening music: guzheng and a light-hearted erhu over a soft plucked rhythm, a cheerful old man packing for exile and cracking jokes so his family will smile, tender with a playful wink, F major pentatonic, 78 bpm. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_river2
items.text: The cheeky plucked guzheng theme returns, bright and jaunty: dawn on a wide river, a small boat setting off, a happy bounce with pipa and woodblock, hopeful and fun, G major pentatonic, 100 bpm, it starts at once. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_beach2
items.text: A silly, cheeky island tune: plucked pipa and guzheng with marimba, a bouncy hand drum and comic woodblock hits, a happy old man secretly grilling oysters on a beach and very pleased with himself, G major pentatonic, 112 bpm, it starts at once. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: sting_luo
items.text: A Peking opera percussion punchline: one bright clash of small gong and cymbals, a single comic hit, short.

items.name: sting_tai
items.text: A single small Chinese opera gong hit with a rising comic pitch bend, short.

items.name: sting_oops
items.text: A playful descending plucked pipa glissando, a comic oops sound, short.
